text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> showed superb adaptability to the turf of 
Longchamp and claimed victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Neither the public nor the project members 
could hide their excitement at these 
results. And for that very reason, they 
vowed to redouble their efforts for the 
real deal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A dream reached for countless times, yet 
never grasped. A dream that so many had 
begun to give up on as impossible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
“The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is a pipe 
dream”— The era of such claims was drawing 
to a close. Japan's long-cherished 
ambition was right before their eyes.
